## Introduction to lab safety and pipetting

We discuss lab safety and resources to work safely with organisms such as *Delftia acidovorans*, review background on the organism, and learn about the tools we use in the lab, starting with mechanical pipettes.

## Learning objectives

- Describe key safety considerations for the genetics and microbiology teaching labs.
- List the personal protective equipment (PPE) needed.
- Identify the features of the mechanical pipettes; explain advantages of electronic and multichannel pipettes.
- Describe the advantages of an electronic lab notebook (ELN) and create a lab entry.
- Collect and interpret pipetting data.
- Create a team charter and communication plan.


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
quiz("lab1q1", "Which is required PPE in a microbiology teaching lab?", ["Lab coat, gloves and eye protection", "Sandals", "Open-toed shoes", "None"], 0, "Always wear appropriate PPE.")
```

### Key takeaways
- Always wear appropriate PPE.
- Record pipetting data in your ELN and agree on a team charter.
:::
